lines.en: I fly low across the ground
My purple scales shine in the light
My wings are shorter than my body

lines.zh: 我从遗迹的石柱间穿过
lines.en: I pass between the ruins' pillars

lines.zh: 尾巴在后面拖着扫过沙
lines.en: My tail drags and sweeps the sand
I land on four feet and walk a few steps
My neck stays stretched forward
My wingtips touch the ground when I run

lines.zh: 我在龙之手遗迹附近转
lines.en: I circle near the Drakvyrn Hand ruins

lines.zh: 我的爪子在大石上留痕
lines.en: My claws leave marks on the big stones

lines.zh: 我从这块碎石跳上那根柱子
lines.en: I leap from this rubble onto that pillar

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在后面压出一条线
lines.en: My tail presses a line behind me

lines.zh: 我伏在一块倒下的柱子上
lines.en: I lie on a fallen pillar
My purple wing membrane is half open
I listen to the wind through the ruins
My tail twitches slightly
I wait for eggs to hatch

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在石缝里回响
lines.en: My breathing echoes in the stone cracks

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处发紫光
lines.en: My eyes glow violet in the dark
I rest my head on my claws
My wing bones are harder than they look

lines.zh: 我的翅尖在沙上慢慢划
lines.en: My wingtip slowly draws in the sand
I count how many eggs are in the nest
My tongue runs over my teeth

lines.zh: 我的紫色在夕阳里更深
lines.en: My purple is deeper in the low sun

lines.zh: 你闯进了龙之手的地盘
lines.en: You have trespassed on the Drakvyrn Hand
This clutch is mine

lines.zh: 我还没决定要不要打你
lines.en: I have not decided whether to fight you
You carry another's scent

lines.zh: 我的紫色是这遗迹的颜色
lines.en: My purple is the color of these ruins

lines.zh: 你的靴尖碰到我的蛋壳了。
lines.en: Your boot tip is touching my eggshell.
My forepaw is already out
Get behind the pillar
I do not want to waste my strength

lines.zh: 我的小家伙们需要一个安静的地方
lines.en: My little ones need a quiet place
The sand under your feet is my nest

lines.zh: 我看着你，不代表我怕你
lines.en: Watching you does not mean I fear you
A tear opened in my wing membrane
I shed a few purple scales
One low growl, throat vibrating.
This made me shake with pain
I retreat behind the pillar
My forepaw is still raised
My purple fire dimmed a moment
My wing membrane still holds
Head down, licking the wound.

lines.zh: 龙鳞被划开一道，我记住了。
lines.en: A scale is gashed open; I won't forget.
That bit of meat is not worth a look
Put it down and back away

lines.zh: 这遗迹里没什么可吃的
lines.en: There is little to eat in these ruins
My eggs need no concern from you
Your hand shook once
Put it on the ground first
This thing is glaring bright

lines.zh: 你手里的肉，不如蛋重要。
lines.en: The meat in your hand matters less than my eggs.
You hit my wing membrane
I spread my wings at once

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，沙被扬起
lines.en: We collided and sand flew up

lines.zh: 我的鳞片擦过你的衣服
lines.en: My scales scraped your clothes
I backed half a step and crouched again
That made me warier
My tail lashed a full circle
Do not come any closer
No wound, but I remember it
I stand in front of the eggs

lines.zh: 我们在遗迹里成对守着
lines.en: We keep watch as a pair in the ruins
Purple scales belong with purple
My eggs already have a keeper
My mate is brooding; stay away.

lines.zh: 我们一起把沙盖在蛋上
lines.en: We cover the eggs with sand together

lines.zh: 我低下头碰了碰它的角
lines.en: I lower my head to touch its horn
One ruin, one clutch
We need no one else
I lay my wing over its back
We go on guarding
I pin it with a claw
This can go under the eggs
I watch everything on the ground
I pick it up and look
This piece is too hard to bite
This stone won't fit in the nest.
I hold it under me, denying it
This scale, I keep for myself.
The sand moved over there
My wings press forward
It is not one of my kind

lines.zh: 远古蛋里孵出来的，不客气。
lines.en: Hatched from an ancient egg. No mercy.

lines.zh: 这个距离我可以一次扑到
lines.en: One leap covers this distance

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里发了一声响
lines.en: A sound rolled in my throat
It is already in my sight
It stands between me and the eggs

lines.zh: 我没打算让你走到那里
lines.en: I did not intend to let you get there
My claws have dug into the sand
Not one egg of this clutch may be lost
I begin moving toward you

lines.zh: 我的紫色从阴影里出来
lines.en: My purple comes out of the shadow
I am set to spring
It has backed toward the pillar

lines.zh: 我的紫色在阴影里不明显
lines.en: My purple is not obvious in the shadow
I sit and let it move first
My tail is pressed low
I calculate with every step it takes

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地面抓了一下
lines.en: My claws rake the ground once
A little closer and I pounce
I track you between the pillars

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩在石头上没有声音
lines.en: My claws make no sound on stone
You retreat, I do not chase far

lines.zh: 我在守一个不能丢的东西
lines.en: I am guarding something that must not be lost

lines.zh: 我把它逼到没有沙的地方
lines.en: I drive it where there is no sand
My throat keeps rumbling
I wait for it to make its own mistake
I lunge and strike with my forepaws
My teeth sink into its shoulder
One wingbeat shoves it back
My tail whips across

lines.zh: 这一下带着紫火的余温
lines.en: This one carries the warmth of purple fire
I bite once and withdraw
I keep it pinned down
I pounce down from the pillar

lines.zh: 我的紫火先到，爪子后到
lines.en: My purple fire arrives first, my claws after
This blow is to drive it off
I bite its leg and drag it back
I knock it aside and shield the nest
I press it into the sand

lines.zh: 我从遗迹的阴影里爬出来
lines.en: I crawl out of the ruins' shadow

lines.zh: 紫色的鳞先反了一下光
lines.en: My purple scales catch the light first

lines.zh: 我在龙之手守着我的蛋
lines.en: I keep my eggs at the Drakvyrn Hand
My wings still carry sand

lines.zh: 我把身体压低贴近地面
lines.en: I press my body low to the ground
I walk slowly around the ruins
I have arrived, this place is mine

lines.zh: 我从遗迹的石板下钻出来
lines.en: I slip out from under the ruins' flagstones

lines.zh: 紫火的余烬落在我脚边
lines.en: Embers of purple fire fall at my feet
My nest is right below here

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在窄处收了起来
lines.en: I fold my wings in the tight space

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看通到外面的路
lines.en: I look up at the way out

lines.zh: 我一步一步走到开阔处
lines.en: I walk step by step into the open
My scales open layer by layer
My voice reached out first

lines.zh: 我自己的火反扑到我的鳞上
lines.en: My own fire lashed back across my scales
I fell from the pillar into the sand
Water filled my wing membrane, very heavy

lines.zh: 爆炸把遗迹的碎石全掀起来
lines.en: The blast threw all the ruins' rubble into the air
A white mark on my purple scales.

lines.zh: 那股术力在我鳞下打转
lines.en: That magic churned under my scales

lines.zh: 我守蛋守了太久，没吃过东西
lines.en: I have guarded the eggs too long without eating
Lightning struck my horn
The ruins have no bottom
